mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (historical median), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.5pp in 3 months), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline of housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening consumer sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 1 month, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic shock regime, a decline in the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) relative to the previous month signals deflationary pressures and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during the post-pandemic shock regime when CPIAUCSL declines, or the average return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A level of industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (the 2017 base) indicates a contraction in the industrial sector, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 100, or the average return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units in a single month signals a weakening real estate market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST falls below 1200.0, or the average return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between declining non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 0 and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS growth < 0 and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in quarterly real GDP (GDPC1) below its 4-quarter moving average signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when GDPC1 declines below its 4-quarter moving average, or the average return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
